teaser: Restlessness keeps a house key here. You are a 5, built for motion and change, set inside an ISFJ frame that keeps the same key on the same hook for years. The 5 wants the next town, the next version of itself; the ISFJ half wants the people already in this one fed, warm, accounted for. What makes this crossing particular is how quietly the wanting hides: not a loud wanderer, but someone who refolds an itinerary into a grocery list and calls it a compromise that rarely feels like one.
